title: Obsidian
metaDescription: Natural black stones, stone to stone in 18K white gold — the darkest stone against the brightest frame. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Black has its own authority. It does not borrow light. It commands it. Stone to stone in white gold — a continuous line, unbroken from start to finish. No gap between them. No softening. The darkest stone against the brightest frame. This is not a bracelet that speaks first.

specs.label: Stones
specs.body: Continuous full-eternity setting of natural black stones, set stone to stone with no metal visible between.

specs.label: Setting
specs.body: Stone-to-stone throughout — no gap, no interruption. Set in 18K white gold. The contrast between the black stones and the white gold frame is the design.

specs.label: Finish
specs.body: High-polish white gold throughout. The darkest stone against the brightest frame — nothing softened, nothing mediated.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Designed and made in Los Angeles. Available by private inquiry. Sizing and specification confirmed at time of order.
